units.source_text: 有一天，内侍替皇上梳发。

en.t: One day, a Naishi combed the Emperor's hair.

units.source_text: 梳毕之后，皇上召唤掌管衣服的宫女，入内换衣服去了。

en.t: After she had finished combing it, the Emperor summoned the ladies-in-waiting in charge of his clothes and went inside to change.
At that moment there was no one else in the room.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看见内侍这一天打扮得比平日更加漂亮：身材俊俏，脂粉浓艳，衣服装饰都很华美，样子异常风骚。

en.t: Prince Genji saw that the Naishi had dressed herself more beautifully than usual that day: her figure looked trim, her powder and rouge were vivid, her clothes and ornaments were all splendid, and her manner was unusually coquettish.

units.source_text: 他想：“老婆娘还要装年轻！”

en.t: He thought, "The old woman is still trying to look young!"
The thought made him feel very displeased.

units.source_text: 然而又不肯就此罢休，想道：“不知她自己心里作何感想。”

en.t: Yet he was not willing to leave it at that, and thought, "I wonder what she herself thinks of it."

units.source_text: 便伸手将她的衣裾拉一把。

en.t: So he reached out and gave the hem of her robe a tug.

units.source_text: 但见她拿起一把色彩非常鲜丽的纸扇来遮住了口，回过头来向公子送一个异常娇媚的秋波。

en.t: He saw her lift a paper fan of extraordinarily bright colors to cover her mouth, then turn back and cast the prince an unusually seductive glance.

units.source_text: 可是那眼睑已经深深地凹进，颜色发黑；头发蓬乱。

en.t: But her eyelids were already deeply sunken and dark, and her hair was disheveled.

units.source_text: 公子看到这模样，想道：“这色彩鲜丽的扇子和这衰老的年纪，真不相称啊！”

en.t: Seeing her like this, the prince thought, "That brilliantly colored fan and this old age truly do not match!"

units.source_text: 便将自己手里的扇子和她交换一下，拿过来一看，但见鲜艳夺目的深红色地子上，用泥金画着许多繁茂的树木，一旁草草地题着一首古歌：“林下衰草何憔悴，驹不食兮人不刈。”[\[13\]](#part1336.html#m13)

en.t: He then exchanged the fan in his hand for hers and looked at it. On a dazzling deep-crimson ground, many luxuriant trees were painted in gold paint, and to one side an old poem had been hastily inscribed: "How withered are the fading grasses beneath the trees; the foals do not eat them, and people do not cut them."[\[13\]](#part1336.html#m13)

units.source_text: 笔致虽然苍老，但也不无风趣。

en.t: Although the brushwork had an aged quality, it was not without charm.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了觉得可笑，想道：“尽可题别的诗句，何必用这杀风景的歌词呢？”

en.t: Prince Genji found it amusing when he saw it, and thought, "She could have written some other verse; why use such a mood-spoiling line?"

units.source_text: 便对她说：“不是这等说法，有道是‘试听杜宇正飞鸣，夏日都来宿此林’[\[14\]](#part1336.html#m14)。 ”

en.t: So he said to her, "That is not how one should put it. There is a saying: 'Listen to the cuckoo as it flies and calls; in summer all come to lodge in this grove.'[\[14\]](#part1336.html#m14)"

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得和这个人讲这些风流韵语，有点不配，深恐被人听见，颇不放心。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that exchanging such elegant, romantic wordplay with this woman was somewhat unsuitable, and he was very uneasy, deeply afraid someone might overhear them.

units.source_text: 但这老女却满不在乎，吟道：

en.t: But the old woman was utterly unconcerned, and recited:
